notes: Release date: page asset timestamps 20260407 (e.g. 20260407-235121.jpeg) and OpenRouter listing 2026-04-07; HuggingFace zai-org/GLM-5.1 createdAt 2026-04-03T09:28:47Z (weights three days early). GLM-5.1 claims state-of-the-art on SWE-Bench Pro at release. Long-horizon demos with disclosed metrics: VectorDBBench 21.5k QPS over 600+ iterations / 6,000+ tool calls (vs prior best 3,547 QPS by Opus 4.6 under 50-turn budget; restructured outer-loop harness with Claude Code); KernelBench Level 3 geometric-mean speedup 3.6x (Opus 4.6 4.2x), 1,200-turn cap, H100 per problem, correctness atol=rtol=1e-4, anti-exploitation audits by Opus 4.6 (max) + GPT-5.4 (xhigh), lower-audit score used, 50x hard cap. Protocol footnotes: reasoning tasks temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / max_new_tokens 163,840, text-only subset default, GPT-5.2 (medium) judge; HLE w/tools 202,752 max context. SWE-Bench Pro: OpenHands, temp 1 / top_p 0.95 / 32k / 200K context. NL2Repo: temp 1.0 / top_p 1.0 / 32k / 200k with rule+model anti-hack. BrowseComp: without CM retains last 5 turns; with CM discard-all (same as GLM-5 and DeepSeek-V3.2). TB 2.0 Terminus: 3h timeout, temp 1.0 / top_p 1.0 / 8192 max new tokens, 200K context, 16 CPU/32GB. TB 2.0 Claude Code 2.1.69 think mode: max_new_tokens 128k via proxy, avg over 5 runs. CyberGym: CC 2.1.56 (no web tools) vs Gemini CLI 0.36.0 vs Codex CLI 0.118.0 (different harnesses per competitor - disclosed), 250-min timeout, single-run Pass@1 over 1,507 tasks; competitor refusals noted as score-lowering. MCP-Atlas: think mode, 500-task public set, 10-min timeout, Gemini-3.0-Pro judge. tau3-bench: extra user-simulator prompt; banking domain terminal-based retrieval; user simulator GPT-5.2 (reasoning_effort low), 4 trials. Vending Bench 2: run independently by Andon Labs (third party). Table columns: GLM-5.1 | GLM-5 | Qwen3.6-Plus | MiniMax M2.7 | DeepSeek-V3.2 | Kimi K2.5 | Claude Opus 4.6 | Gemini 3.1 Pro | GPT-5.4.
